verdict.rationale: The Profile API documents programmatic reads of user and account traits, events and external_ids, so the 'query customer data' half is covered. The Public API offers documented CRUD with an OpenAPI spec, tokens, rate limits and versioning, but its listed resources are Sources, Destinations, Warehouses and Tracking Plans. Audiences are described only as built and synced in Engage, with no evidence that they can be created or activated through the API or an MCP server. missing for 10: documented API/MCP endpoints for creating and activating audiences, an official MCP server, end-to-end agent workflow evidence, independent hands-on corroboration.
